text:
alex_sales: Hey team — Zephyr (banking prospect) asked for a performance POC + security handoff. They want sustained 200 qps for chat completion with p95 < 150ms and a clear pricing estimate. Can we scope a run this week?

maya_se: I can own the test plan. Suggest: smoke (30m), ramp to 200 qps over 15m, 2h sustained, and a 30m soak with bursts to 400 qps. We'll collect p50/p95/p99, token counts, and GPU utilization.

dave_perf: For initial run I'll use 4xA10s on Dedicated, seq len buckets: short(<=64), medium(65-256), long(>256) with sample mix 50/35/15. Shotgun config: batching=auto, max_batch_tokens=4096, kv_cache=true. Load runner command:```bash
vegeta attack -targets=zephyr.targets -rate=200 -duration=2h | vegeta report
```

rui_sre: FYI Zephyr requires IP allowlist + egress via their VPC peering. For Dedicated we need to validate MTU and firewall rules; for Private we'd hand off a deployment package + KMS config. I'll draft the network checklist.

carla_security: On the questionnaire — they flagged KMS/HSM and encryption in transit at rest, plus SOC2 attestation and logging retention. We can provide our SOC2 report and outline that Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (HSM integration add-on). I'll attach the short Q&A doc in the readout.

alex_sales: Great. What's the rough burn/cost estimate for a 4xA10 3h run (including ramp/soak)? Need a number to put in the SOW.

maya_se: Ballpark: compute ~ 3 GPU-hours * list price * reserved discount estimate -> ~ $Xk for the run. I'll compute a more precise estimate with token cost baseline and send.

dave_perf: Quick note on expectations: cold starts (first few minutes) will show higher p99. With cache warming we hit p95 ~ 110-130ms for mixed load at 200 qps. p99 tends to be ~2x p95 during bursts. I'll include charts.

ops-bot: Deploy job #deploy-zee-412 initiated by dave_perf — provisioning 4xA10 Dedicated cluster (ETA ~ 12m). :rocket:

rui_sre: Also adding connection test command for Zephyr networking team:
```bash
# from customer VPC
curl -ik https://redwood-dedicated-zephyr.example/healthz
```

carla_security: For the questionnaire answer snippet we propose: 
```
Encryption
- In transit: TLS1.2+
- At rest: AES-256 via customer KMS option
- HSM: supported via BYOK HSM integration
```

alex_sales: Perfect. Ethan (Zephyr) — can you confirm compliance lead availability on Thurs 10am PT for a 30m security handoff and Fri 2pm PT for the performance readout?

ethan_zephyr: Thanks — Thu 10am works for compliance. Fri 2pm for readout is good. Appreciate the rapid turnaround.

maya_se: I'll post the detailed runbook and the short evaluation prompt set in this thread before EOD.

dave_perf: Post-run quick findings (summary): sustained 210 qps achieved, p95=120ms, p99=230ms, avg GPU util 78%, token cost aligned with our estimate. Noted one tail spike during noisy neighbor interference — mitigated by setting batch cap to 3072. I'll attach CSV and sample latency graph in the readout.

alex_sales: Awesome — I'll update the SOW with the cost and schedule the two meetings. :thumbsup:

ethan_zephyr: Thanks everyone — looking forward to the readout.
